results.transcript: President: Okay, we're recording. Board meeting, June eighteenth, twenty twenty-six. All three of us are here. Secretary: Before the pool item, can we talk about barbecues? ... President: So we all lean towards allowing electric barbecues. Let's not vote tonight. Secretary, can you check with the insurer, and we'll put a proper motion on the September agenda. Secretary: Will do. I'll ask the insurer by the end of July. ... President: Someone said the notice says nine pm, but I thought we said ten. Treasurer: We'll look at that next time.

items.text: Board leans towards allowing electric barbecues; no vote taken; motion planned for September agenda
items.quote: So we all lean towards allowing electric barbecues. Let's not vote tonight.
